headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat amid volatility as hospital stocks tumble and monsoon concerns weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Hospital stocks fell up to 6% after the Supreme Court questioned drug mark-ups
Geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran along with oil volatility dampened investor sentiment
India recorded its lowest monsoon rainfall in over a decade due to the impact of El Nino
The market is on track to post its worst nine-month performance in 15 years
whatHappening: The Sensex and Nifty 50 traded in a narrow range, ultimately closing nearly flat after a volatile session
Vedanta raised ₹2,000 crore through the issuance of non-convertible debentures
Banking and realty stocks outperformed the broader market while pharma and hospital shares faced selling pressure
The Cabinet increased the minimum support price for wheat by ₹25 to ₹2,610 per quintal for the 2027-28 season
summary: The Indian stock market ended a volatile session flat, with the Nifty closing at 22,620 and the Sensex failing to maintain early gains. Hospital stocks saw significant declines following Supreme Court scrutiny on drug pricing, while banking and realty sectors provided some support. Investors remain cautious due to weak monsoon data and ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
